title: Set up #embassy for PERMAFLEET
description: Gives a member org an #embassy channel where other orgs and alliance leadership can reach it. goon.vc's bot creates it, or the server's own channel is used.

welcome.say: Hi {{user.name}}! Every PERMAFLEET member org keeps an **#embassy** channel, where other orgs and alliance leadership can reach it. Let's set one up on **{{context.guildName}}**.

channel.say: Should goon.vc's bot create #embassy? That's the recommended way: it's set up the same on every member org's Discord. Or pick a channel **{{context.guildName}}** already has.

category.say: Which category should #embassy go in? It stays open to everyone on your server, whatever the category allows.

permissions.say:
To create #embassy, goon.vc's bot needs **Manage Channels**, plus the permissions it opens up there. Missing on **{{context.guildName}}** right now: {{context.channelMissing}}.
Grant them with this link (it updates the bot if it's already in your server), then press Continue: {{context.channelInviteUrl}}

summary.say:
Here's the plan for **{{context.guildName}}**:
- Create #embassy, where everyone on your server can read and post
- Category: {{labels.category|none, top of the channel list}}

Go ahead?

existing.say:
I'll use {{labels.channel}} as #embassy on **{{context.guildName}}** and leave its permissions as they are. Visitors from other orgs should be able to read and post there.

Go ahead?

complete.say: {{labels.result}} Post an invite to it in #embassy on the G00N SQUAD Discord so alliance leadership can reach you. Run `/goon embassy` again any time.

cancelled.say: Nothing changed. Run `/goon embassy` in your server to start again.
